reviews.text:
When I was little, there was a kitten in the park near my house that looked like it had been hit by a car and was in critical condition. We were so young and didn't know what to do, but we remembered that this hospital was nearby. Even though we were too young to know how much medical care would cost, we all brought our piggy banks from home and, crying, asked, "Please, please save the kitten!" They kindly said, "You don't need to pay! Leave the kitten to us! It'll be alright!" and readily accepted the kitten. Now, 30 years later, having helped with animal rescue activities, I feel incredibly sorry for what we did. On the other hand, I'm still filled with immense gratitude. I truly believe this is a wonderful hospital that genuinely cares for animals. This review is 30 years late, but I wholeheartedly support them.

Thank you so much for everything back then.
They examine pets very carefully. This is a veterinary hospital where you can entrust your pet with peace of mind.

It's a little hard to find.
The teachers are calm and kind.

I moved to a neighborhood nearby this hospital about two years ago, and that's why I've been taking care of my two dogs here! I'm so grateful for everything!

they definitely get better the next day!
I'm a worrier, so I always ask about everything, but the doctor always explains things until I feel at ease! The nurses are also very friendly, which somehow makes me feel at ease!
I think the prices are reasonable too!
